Manx: ta mee paagh as accryssagh agglagh ghooinney
ta mee laccal goll dys y thie-bee as eisht ta mee laccal gee peetsey er y traie
ta mee cheet agh ta orrym goll dys balley chashtal
cre'n oyr ta goll dys shen vel oo gobbraghey shen
cha nel ta orrym goll dys y phurt aer
bee yn carrey aym breeshey er yn ellan son laa ny jees
well ta mee toiggal c'red vees ee fuirraghtyn
ayns y thie aym as c'raad ta'n thie ayd
theihll shoh ta mee beaghey ayns doolish nish
as nagh vel barroose cheet dys doolish voish y fer ta
oh ta ta ram barrooseyn cheet voish balley chashtal dys doolish
vel oo shickyr nagh vel oo laccal goll dys y thie-bee eisht
er lhiam dy bee yn carrey ayd mie dy liooar er y varroose
